0022600034.text: The Indiana Pacers (4-8, 3-7 in their last 10) host the New York Knicks (6-5, 6-4 in their last 10) on a one-game winning streak, while New York is on a one-game losing streak. Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), Ben Sheppard (knee), and Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with knee soreness and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Pacers lost the season series 1-3, including a 136-110 loss in New York on March 17.
